vectors.name: error_response_user_declined
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request: MSG_TYPE 0xc5 is response, error, TYPE 0x05. ERROR is 0x01 (user declined) and ERROR_MESSAGE is "signing was declined".

vectors.name: error_response_vendor
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request with the vendor code 0xff, where the meaning is only in ERROR_MESSAGE, here "device is locked".

vectors.name: error_response_private_key_export_refused
vectors.description: Error response to a Get Keys request: MSG_TYPE 0xc2 is response, error, TYPE 0x02. ERROR is 0x0c (private key export refused) and ERROR_MESSAGE is "private key export refused".

vectors.name: error_response_musig_session
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request: MSG_TYPE 0xc5 is response, error, TYPE 0x05. ERROR is 0x0d (MuSig2 session missing or mismatch) and ERROR_MESSAGE is "musig2 session missing".

vectors.name: error_response_already_registered
vectors.description: Error response to a Register Descriptor request: MSG_TYPE 0xc3 is response, error, TYPE 0x03. ERROR is 0x0e (descriptor alias already registered) and ERROR_MESSAGE is "alias already registered".

vectors.name: error_response_unsupported_operation
vectors.description: Error response to an Address Verification request: MSG_TYPE 0xc4 is response, error, TYPE 0x04. ERROR is 0x0f (unsupported operation), a silent payment address sent to a signer without capability bit 2, and ERROR_MESSAGE is "silent payments not supported".

vectors.name: error_response_network_mismatch
vectors.description: Error response to a Signing request: MSG_TYPE 0xc5 is response, error, TYPE 0x05. ERROR is 0x10 (network mismatch), a PSBT for a network the signer does not sign for, and ERROR_MESSAGE is "wrong network".

vectors.name: error_response_reserved_code
vectors.description: Error response to a Get Keys request with ERROR 0x11, taken from the range reserved for future standard codes. A version 1 parser does not know it and must still accept the message and fall back to ERROR_MESSAGE.
